title: Microsoft Teams: new sharing panel in meetings
summary: Hold: the PowerShell control is missing the value or placeholder required by its ScreenSharingMode parameter, so administrators cannot run it as printed. The supplied notice supports the default-on experience, lack of a tenant-level off switch, scope and rollout windows; the documented admin navigation also checks out.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: API and automation
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -ScreenSharingMode is a usable automation call for screen sharing mode as printed.
claims.quote:
[-ScreenSharingMode <String>]

Determines the mode in which a user can share a screen in calls or meetings. Set this to SingleApplication to allow the user to share an application at a given point in time.
claims.fix: Replace the call in controls[1].api and the rendered table with 'Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -ScreenSharingMode <mode>'. Set its docs URL to https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy?view=teams-ps and cite that reference; mode must be SingleApplication, EntireScreen or Disabled. The current call omits the string argument required when -ScreenSharingMode is supplied.
